description: Three quills in blue, orange and gold, still bound together. Whatever wore them was worth looking at.
lore: Nothing wore all three. They are off three different somethings, and the binding is the item: a woman saw a bird once, alive, in a life she has otherwise let go of, and she has been matching its colours out of junk sacks ever since. The blue took four months. The orange is close and she knows it is not right. She brings them to [[lore/the_age_of_fires|a fire]] most weeks and describes the bird in order, one feather at a time, and has not yet reached the beak before the wood runs out.
gm_notes: A telling that never finishes, kept alive by the telling. She is unnamed on purpose; drop her into any fire scene that needs a warm one.
